November 07, 2024EXPARTECalAdvocates/Shek/CPUCNOTICE OF EX PARTE MEETING OF THE PUBLIC ADVOCATES OFFICE Pursuant to Rule 8.4 of the California Public Utilities Commissions (Commissions) Rules of Practice and Procedure, the Public Advocates Office at the California Public Utilities Commission (Cal Advocates) provides this notice on an ex parte meeting with President Alice Reynolds advisors, Hannah Ford-Stille and Khalil Johnson. The meeting took place via Webex on Monday, November 4, 2024, at 9:35 am and lasted until approximately 10:05 pm. Hannah Stille-Ford and Khalil Johnson attended on behalf of President Reynolds. Michael Campbell and Selina Shek attended for Cal Advocates. Hayley Goodson attended for The Utility Reform Network (TURN), and Ann Trowbridge attended for the Agricultural Energy Consumers Association (AECA). Nora Sheriff attended for the California Large Energy Consumers Association (CLECA) (as an interested party). This diverse group of consumer advocates and PG&E customers requested the meeting to express their concerns with Pacific Gas & Electric Companys (PG&E) request, made through the filing of a motion, to increase its energization capital cost caps to over $4.4 billion.

October 30, 2024EXPARTECAL ADOVCATES/FISHER/CPUCTHREE-DAY ADVANCE NOTICE OF EX PARTE MEETING OF THE PUBLIC ADVOCATES OFFICE Pursuant to Rule 8.2(c) of the California Public Utilities Commissions (Commission) Rules of Practice and Procedure and Public Utilities Code section 1701.3(h)(2), the Public Advocates Office at the California Public Utilities Commission (Cal Advocates), hereby provides this notice of an ex parte meeting with Hannah Ford-Stille and Khalil Johnson, Advisors to President Alice Reynolds, to discuss Pacific Gas and Electric Company's (PG&Es) "Motion to Revise 2025 and 2026 Energization Cost Caps," in relation to Commission Rulemaking (R).24-01-018 and PG&Es General Rate Case proceeding, A.21-06-021. The meeting is scheduled for 30 minutes on Monday, November 4, 2024, at 9:30 AM, and will take place via WebEx.
